# Floating Pragma

Floating Pragma is an independent research studio for observer-first physics, scientific simulation, verifiable computation, and security research.

## Canonical OPH Surfaces

- Website and research overview: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/
- Textbooks and guided learning: https://learn.floatingpragma.io/
- Interactive OPH Lab: https://oph-lab.floatingpragma.io/
- Public source repository: https://github.com/FloatingPragma/observer-patch-holography/
- Mini-universe simulation: https://simulation.floatingpragma.io/
- OPH Webbook v2, in preparation: https://oph-book.floatingpragma.io/

## Research Record

- Paper release: r2022, 20 August 2026
- Paper index with first-party HTML and PDF editions: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/
- Flagship reconstruction paper: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/from-observer-consensus-to-standard-physics/
- Machine-readable paper inventory: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/papers.json
- Paper-specific LLM index: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/llms.txt
- Paper sitemap: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/sitemap.xml

Observer Patch Holography studies bounded, self-reading systems with local state, ports or boundaries, readback, records, feedback, and repair. Exact finite results, conditional reconstruction results, simulations, diagnostics, and open physical identification steps are classified separately.
